Forwarding the Northwind Supplies invoice INV-2291 below.

Please note: Northwind sent a follow-up on 2026-10-04 ("Correction: INV-2291") saying the amount was wrong and the corrected amount is $1,180.00, still due October 20, 2026. That correction email is also included below.

Kind regards,
Northwind Supplies, Billing

Sorry for the confusion,
Northwind Supplies, Billing

Best,
Dana Kim
Acme Outdoor Support
